QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Life Finds a Way
QuestInfo.0: Now that you've arrived in Magatia, go have another chat with Eremos.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos is fascinated by a group called the Zenumists in Magatia. He wants to know whether the organisms they created are capable of housing a soul. Collect 500 samples from the Homunculus organisms created by the Zenumists and share what you learn with Eremos.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered enough Homunculus samples, but when you contacted Eremos, Surana had a request of her own.
